_doc: Seasonal events, recurring every year between start and end (MM-DD, inclusive, local date; end < start wraps over New Year). featured items sell for sell_mult at the stall. goal: contribute items to the event board for the reward. Add a new event here — no code changes needed.

spring_blossom.name: Spring Blossom Fair
spring_blossom.text: The orchards are in bloom! Bring flowers and fresh greens for the fair.

summer_berry.name: Midsummer Berry Bash
summer_berry.text: Basil wants berries. All the berries. For science (and pies).

harvest_moon.name: Harvest Moon Festival
harvest_moon.text: The big autumn festival! Pumpkins, pies and lanterns everywhere.

winter_cozy.name: Cozy Winter Nights
winter_cozy.text: Snow on the roof, a fire in the hearth. The valley needs warm blankets and soup.

autumn_preview.name: Autumn Apple-less Picnic
autumn_preview.text: Juniper is hosting a picnic for the animals. Eggs and milk, please!
